compositions.title_en: The song of the lettuce: a balbale to Inana (Dumuzid-Inana E)

segments.orig:
ba-lam ba-lam-lam ḫi-iz{sar}-am₃ a ba-an-dug₄
{ĝiš}kiri₆ ĝi₆-edin-na gu₂ ĝar-ĝar-ra-na {sag₉-ga ama-na-ĝu₁₀} {(1 ms. ḫas instead:) ḫi-iz{sar} a ba-an-de₂}
še ab-sin₂-ba ḫi-li-a sag₉-ĝu₁₀ ḫi-iz{sar}-am₃ a ba-an-dug₄
{ĝiš}ḫašḫur aĝ₂ saĝ-ĝa₂ gurun il₂-la-ĝu₁₀ ḫi-iz{sar}-am₃ a ba-an-dug₄
segments.en: He has sprouted, he has burgeoned, he is well-watered lettuce, my shaded garden of the desert, richly flourishing, {his mother's favourite} {(1 ms. has instead:) he is well-watered lettuce}; my grain lovely in beauty in its furrows, he is well-watered lettuce; my first-class fruitful apple tree, he is well-watered lettuce.

segments.orig:
lu₂-lal₃-e lu₂-lal₃-e me-e mu-ku₇-ku₇-de₃-en
en-ĝu₁₀ lu₂-lal₃-e dim₃-me-er-ra sag₉-ga ama-na-ĝu₁₀
šu-ni lal₃-e /me\-ri-ni lal₃-e ĝe₂₆-e mu-un-ku₇-ku₇-de₃-[en]
a₂-šu-ĝiri₃-ni lal₃ ku₇-ku₇-dam ĝe₂₆-e mu-un-ku₇-ku₇-[de₃-en]
segments.en: The honey man, the honey man will make me sweet; my lord, the honey man of a goddess, his mother's favourite, whose hands are honey, whose feet are honey, will make me sweet, whose limbs are honey-sweet, will make me sweet.

segments.orig:
en₃-dur šu-niĝin₂ tukum ku₇-ku₇-ĝu₁₀ /sag₉\-[ga ama-na-ĝu₁₀]
/ḫaš₄\ sag₉-sag₉ a₂ buluĝ₅ e-ru-ĝu₁₀ ḫi-iz{sar}-am₃ [a ba-an-dug₄]
segments.en: Navel! My altogether immediately sweet, my favourite of his mother! Beautiful thighs, raised arms! My ……, he is well-watered lettuce.
